name: Drum Bus
description: Compressor into a bit of crunch for a drum bus.

name: Vocal Chain
description: Gate, EQ and compression for a lead vocal. No reverb: a true reverb send is bus/mixer routing, which a single effect-chain preset can't express.

name: Mastering Chain
description: Broad EQ into a brickwall limiter for a master bus.

name: Lo-Fi Sampler
description: A crushed, low-pass-filtered piano one-shot for lo-fi chops.

name: Ambient Send
description: Dense reverb into delay for ambient washes.

name: Guitar Cab Convolver
description: Convolver pre-wired to a Modern UK cabinet impulse response.

name: Clean Piano
description: GeneralUser GS's Grand Piano patch (bank 0, preset index 0).

name: Synth Bass
description: Monophonic saw plus sub-square bass with a short, punchy envelope.

name: Orchestral Sketch (Harp)
description: Scoped down from a full orchestral sketch to a single instrument: FreePats GM Orchestral's Orchestral Harp patch (preset index 20), the most genuinely orchestral melodic voice in that soundfont.
